wiki.title: UI Guidelines & Design System
wiki.content:
## Design Principles

1. **Visual Clarity First**: Use crisp vector wireframes, distinct typography scales, and generous whitespace.
2. **Immediate Feedback**: Micro-interactions, animated state transitions, and clear loading states.
3. **Actor-Role Empathy**: Customize interfaces specifically for the active user role.

## Color Palette Tokens

| Role / Intent | Hex Token | Visual Representation |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Primary Brand** | `#6366f1` (Indigo 500) | 🟣 Primary buttons, active tabs |
| **Success / Done** | `#10b981` (Emerald 500) | 🟢 Completed tasks, status indicators |
| **In Progress** | `#f59e0b` (Amber 500) | 🟡 Active execution, pending review |
| **Dark Background** | `#090d16` (Slate 950) | ⬛ Deep obsidian canvas |
| **Surface Card** | `#131b2e` (Slate 900) | 🪟 Frosted glass card containers |

## Layout & Breakpoints

- **Mobile**: `< 640px` — single-column flow, bottom action sheet / bottom tab bar.
- **Tablet**: `640px - 1024px` — flexible grid with collapsible sidebar.
- **Desktop**: `> 1024px` — three-pane view (Navigation + Main Workspace + Bookmarks/Inspector).

wiki.title: Actor Roles & User Journeys
wiki.content:
## Identified Actors

- 👤 **Guest / Visitor**: Unauthenticated user exploring landing pages and feature overviews.
- 🔑 **Authenticated User**: Signed-in member executing tasks, workflows, and viewing personal dashboards.
- 🛡️ **Administrator**: System manager managing configuration, user roles, and monitoring metrics.

## Primary User Flow

```text
[Guest] --> (Visits App) --> [Landing Page]
                                  |
                                  v (Signs Up / Logs In)
                           [Authentication Modal]
                                  |
                                  v (Authorized)
[User]  --> [Main Dashboard] <---> [Interactive Detail Views]
                                  |
                                  v (Admin Privileges)
[Admin] --> [Management Console]
```
